description: Non material Amendment (regarding amount of floorspace used for retail and restaurants [A1, A3/4] within Building 3) of application 00505/P/P73 granted on 13/03/2009 for the retention and alteration of Wallis House in association with the re-instatement of employment use, the creation of a gallery , the provision of a health club and the introduction of residential use of the building. The retention, alteration and extension of International House and its use as a restaurant and incubator business units. The demolition of all other buildings on the site and redevelopment for mixed employment, community and private and affordable residential use, together with associated public and private open spaces, access roads, service areas, 1,045 car parking and landscaping. The proposed buildings range from 4 to 10 storeys in height and a 25- storey tower.
